field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: UT uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor)

field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: UT economic nexus gross receipts threshold: $100,000 (transaction count removed July 1, 2025)

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: UT additions: federal interest income, state income tax refunds, certain expenses, etc.

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: UT tax credits: renewable energy, research activities, economic development, etc.

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: UT subtractions: UT municipal bond interest, state income taxes paid, state NOL, etc.

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: UT corporate income tax rate: 4.50% (reduced from 4.55% effective January 1, 2025) - UT Code § 59-7-104

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: UT transaction threshold removed as of July 1, 2025 per S.B. 47
